[[Bihor County|Bihor County Council]] | chairman = George Tătar | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Erik Lincar]] | league = [[Liga II]] | season = [[2025–26 Liga II|2025–26]] | position = Liga II, 4th of 22 | website = {{URL|https://www.fcbihor.ro/}} | current = 2026–27 FC Bihor Oradea (2022) season | kit_alt1 = |pattern_la1 = _macronsceptrum22rbr |pattern_b1 = _macronsceptrum22rbr |pattern_ra1 = _macronsceptrum22rbr |pattern_sh1 = |pattern_so1 = |leftarm1 = 122560 |body1 = FFFFFF |rightarm1 = 122560 |shorts1 = 122560 |socks1 = 122560 | kit_alt2 = |pattern_la2 = |pattern_b2 = _macroncharoneco23yrn |pattern_ra2 = |pattern_sh2 = |pattern_so2 = |leftarm2 = FFFF00 |body2 = FFFF00 |rightarm2 = FFFF00 |shorts2 = FFFF00 |socks2 = FFFF00 }} {{CSM Oradea sections}} '''Asociația Club Sportiv Fotbalistic Oradea''' ({{IPA|ro|biˈhor oˈrade̯a}}), commonly known as '''Bihor Oradea''' or simply as '''FC Bihor''', is a Romanian professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Oradea]], [[Bihor County]], which competes in the [[Liga II]]. It was founded under the name of ''Crișul Oradea'' in April 1958 and, since 1963, it has continued the football tradition of the city, following the dissolution of [[Club Atletic Oradea]]. FC Bihor played 18 seasons in the first division, the best performance being the 7th-place ranking on three occasions, in the seasons [[Liga I]] 1963–1964, 1983–1984, 1988–1989. At the end of the 2003–2004 season lit was relegated from [[Liga I]], going on to play only in [[Liga II]], failing to get promoted back. In January 2016, after continuously facing major financial problems, FC Bihor went bankrupt and disappeared from Romanian football.{{Cite web |date=13 January 2016 |access-date=30 July 2022 |url=http://www.liga2.prosport.ro/seria-2/adio-fc-bihor-the-Oradean-club-has-officially-entered-bankruptcy-and-can-not-continue-its-activity-the-decision-is-irrevocable-149636541|title=ADIO FC Bihor ! The club from Oradea officially entered bankruptcy and can no longer continue its activity. The decision is irrevocable}} In July 2022, the Oradea City Hall brought the club back to life, which it registered in the [[Liga III]] instead of the [[Club Atletic Oradea]].{{Cite web |date=26 July 2022 |access-date=30 July 2022 |website= |url =https://www.sport.ro/fotbal-intern/a-renascut-fc-bihor-echipa-de-traditie-a-disputat-deja-primul-amical.html/|title=FC Bihor has reborn! {{!}} The traditional team has already played the first friendly}} The colors of the club from Oradea are Red and Blue."}}
